note: Vernon Parish (22115) has no public queryable parcel polygon service found. The only county-linked parcel layer, 'Parcels - LA - Vernon Parish' (GDITAdmin), sits on the EFS Edge host and redirects to a login page. Other parcel sources are commercial (Regrid, Land Records, Dynamo Spatial, Acres). The Vernon_LA Georeferences service holds scanned plats, and Vernon_Parish_Map_WFL1 is an area-of-interest polygon only. The assessor site links to a property search app and an efsedge viewer with no open parcel REST endpoint. The totaland host used by Allen Parish has no Vernon folder.
